meta_desc: AreaInspect develops smart monitoring units with thermal imaging and 4K cameras, acoustic sensors and AI recognition for bats and birds at wind turbines and buildings, and for wild bees at insect hotels.
og_desc: See what is really flying, day and night. Smart monitoring units with thermal imaging, 4K, sound and AI.
hero_h1:
See what is really flying.
Day and night.
hero_intro: AreaInspect develops smart monitoring units with thermal imaging and 4K cameras, acoustic sensors and AI recognition. For bats and birds at wind turbines and buildings, and for wild bees at insect hotels.
hero_vertrouwen: Developed by ecologists, built for the field.
film_hero_label: Video: AreaInspect monitoring unit at a building, day and night
p1_p: Thermal cameras track bats and birds in the dark and record their flight paths in 3D. 4K cameras follow wild bees right up to the nest hole, showing who flies in and out of each opening.
p2_p: An ultrasonic bat detector records bat calls and a bird microphone captures song and flight calls. Every sound is linked to the camera image from the same moment.
p3_p: Our own software recognises species groups in images and sound, counts animals flying in and out, and filters out leaves, rain and noise. Uncertain cases are checked by an ecologist.
p3_li1: image recognition and 3D tracking of flight movements
p3_li2: acoustic analysis of bats and birds
p3_li3: online dashboard with map, alerts and export to GIS, Excel and PDF
p3_li4: models that keep improving with new field footage
p4_p: Every morning, the results of the past night and day are ready in a clear dashboard and report, with charts per hour, per location and per species group. For important observations you receive an immediate alert by email or app:
p4_li1: a collision or casualty at a wind turbine
p4_li4: a fault or outage of the monitoring unit
prod1_sub: Mobile thermal imaging unit for bats and birds, at small wind turbines and at buildings. One unit, two applications.

keuze_gebouw_uitleg: Locate bat roost entrances on two facades at once.

unit_li2: Two thermal cameras for 3D stereo, plus a third camera
unit_li3: Built-in bat detector and bird microphone

unit_li5: Mains power or LiFePO4 batteries, no fuel

wind_h3: Set-up at a small wind turbine
wind_p: The unit stands about 20 to 25 metres south of the turbine, with the mast at 5.8 metres. Both thermal cameras look at the rotor together and record flight movements in 3D.
geb_p: The unit stands about 10 metres diagonally in front of a building corner, with the mast at 3.8 metres. The left camera looks at the left facade, the right camera at the right facade.
prod2_sub: Smart monitoring for insect hotels: three 4K cameras and AI that count which insects fly in and out of each nest hole.
bee_li1: Suitable for existing and new insect hotels
bee_li2: Each nest hole has its own ID in the digital register
bee_li3: Three 4K cameras on a vandal-resistant unit, 1.3 m in front of the nest wall
bee_li4: Recognises solitary bees, honeybees, bumblebees, wasps and hoverflies
bee_li5: Alert for a possible Asian hornet
bee_li6: Own solar panel and 4G, no mains power or Wi-Fi needed
bee_vak1_p: Arrivals and departures, times and occupancy per hole.
bee_vak2_p: With information board and QR code: visitors see what is happening.
alt_bee1: Nest wall seen from below, with bees at the nest holes
alt_bee2: Three 4K cameras scan the nest wall
alt_bee3: Camera unit at an insect hotel on a flower-rich verge
ww1_p: We install the unit on site, aim the cameras at the wind turbine, building or insect hotel and calibrate everything on the spot.
ww2_p: The unit records autonomously, day and night, with cameras and microphones. Only the relevant clips are sent via 4G.
ww3_p: AI recognises and counts the animals and their flight movements. An ecologist checks the uncertain cases, so the results are reliable.
ww4_p: You receive a daily report and a clear final report: a reliable basis for protecting and enhancing nature at your site. All data is also available in the dashboard.

pv_intro: AreaInspect, Newtonlaan 115, 3584 BH Utrecht, handles your data with care. This statement explains which data we process and why.
pv_form_p: If you send us a message, we use your name or organisation, your email address and your message only to answer your question. A message sent through the form is delivered via our own server within the EU as an email to our inbox; your IP address is stored for no more than one hour to prevent abuse and spam. We do not keep your data longer than necessary and do not share it with others.
pv_cookies_p: This website does not set any tracking or advertising cookies and does not load fonts from third parties. Only if you click on a video to view it in 3D does your browser load the 3D software (three.js) via jsDelivr; jsDelivr then sees your IP address.
pv_taal_p: The website selects the language based on your browser's time zone and language setting. This happens only in your browser; no data is sent to us or to anyone else for this purpose. If you choose a language yourself, your browser remembers that choice, so the site opens directly in that language next time.
pv_stat_p: To see how our website is used, AreaInspect itself records which pages are viewed, which website or search engine you came from, and whether you click on our email address or phone number. We do not use cookies for this. Your IP address is stored on our own server within the EU to determine an approximate location and, for business connections, the organisation. It is not shared with third parties and is deleted after 180 days at the latest. The legal basis is our legitimate interest in improving our website.
pv_rechten_p: You can always ask us which data we hold about you, and ask us to correct or delete it. To do so, email info@areainspect.com. If you have a complaint, you can also contact the Dutch data protection authority, the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens.
